title: Disability and Purpose
definition: Disability and purpose means that physical, mental, or life limitations do not remove a person's value, dignity, calling, usefulness, or place in God's kingdom.
summary: Scripture shows that weakness and limitation do not disqualify people from God's love or purpose. God often displays His grace, strength, and glory through human weakness.
christFocus: Christ consistently showed compassion, dignity, and purpose toward people living with limitations and suffering.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture shows that weakness and limitation do not disqualify people from God's love or purpose. God often displays His grace, strength, and glory through human weakness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
